passages.text: OPERATIONS . The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated and combined financial statements, which are prepared in conformity with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), and corresponding notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K . The following discussion and analysis provides information that management believes to be relevant to understanding the financial condition and results of operations of the Company for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 . Unless otherwise noted, tables are presented in U.S. dollars in millions, except for per-share amounts which are presented in U.S. dollars. Certain columns and rows within tables may not add due to the use of rounded numbers. Percentages presented in this report are calculated from the underlying numbers in millions. Unless otherwise noted, statements related to changes in operating results relate to the corresponding period in the prior year. Refer to the "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" included in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 , for discussions of results for the years ended December 31, 2024 versus 2023 . In the accompanying analysis of financial information, we sometimes use information derived from consolidated and combined financial data but not presented in our financial statements prepared in accordance with GAAP. Certain of these data are considered “non-GAAP financial measures” under SEC rules. For the reasons we use these non-GAAP financial measures and the reconciliations to their most directly comparable GAAP financial measures, see " — Non-GAAP Financial Measures." Financial Presentation Under GE Ownership. We completed our separation from General Electric Company (GE), which now operates as GE Aerospace, on April 2, 2024 (the Spin-Off). For further information, see Note 1 in the Notes to the consolidated and combined financial statements. Prolec GE. On October 21, 2025, we announced that GE Vernova will acquire the remaining fifty percent stake of Prolec GE, our unconsolidated joint venture with Xignux. Prolec GE is a leading grid equipment supplier, producing transformers across most ratings and voltages with approximately 10,000 global employees across seven manufacturing sites globally, including five in the U.S. Under the purchase agreement, GE Vernova will pay approximately $5.3 billion at closing, expected to be funded equally between cash and debt. The acquisition is expected to close in February 202 6 . Tariffs. Throughout 2025, the United States and other countries imposed global tariffs. These tariffs have resulted, and any future tariffs will result in additional costs to us. The total cost impact from the global tariffs for the full year 2025 was approximately $250 million , after taking into consideration contractual protections and mitigating actions. credit_strengths.text: GE Vernova's balance sheet carries a substantial net cash position, with cash and short-term investments far exceeding reported borrowings. This net cash cushion, alongside a minimal indicative financial risk profile, places leverage well below the sector median and gives the company unusual financial flexibility for an industrial capital-goods issuer.

Operating cash flow generation is robust and improving, with free cash flow comfortably covering capital expenditure and dwarfing reported debt. Cash flow to debt and free cash flow to debt ratios sit near the top of the sector percentile range, indicating strong internal liquidity generation relative to peers.

key_risks.text: The company faces material tariff cost exposure, with disclosed full-year tariff impacts running into hundreds of millions of dollars after contractual protections and mitigating actions. Future tariff amounts, duration and scope remain uncertain, and these costs could pressure margins if they cannot be passed through to customers or offset by supply-chain actions.

The announced Prolec GE buyout requires a multi-billion-dollar payment funded equally between cash and debt, materially increasing borrowings at closing. This acquisition-related debt could shift the capital structure from net cash toward leverage, and integration or financing execution risk is meaningful given the size relative to current debt outstanding.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is exceptionally strong, with operating income covering cash interest paid many times over. Even after the Prolec GE acquisition adds debt, the company's earnings and cash flow base should comfortably service incremental interest, assuming no severe demand deterioration in grid or power equipment markets.

Free cash flow after capital expenditure is substantial and covers reported debt many times, while the current ratio sits slightly below one, reflecting working-capital intensity typical of large equipment projects. Liquidity remains ample given the cash balance, though restricted cash inclusion may overstate freely available funds.

overall_credit_view.text: GE Vernova presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net cash, high interest coverage and strong free cash flow generation. Leverage and cash-flow metrics compare favorably with sector medians, and the company's grid and power equipment franchise benefits from electrification demand, supporting a constructive credit view.

Key watch items are the debt-funded Prolec GE acquisition, tariff cost inflation and shareholder distributions that absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow. The debt metric is partial, excluding long-term borrowings, so reported leverage likely understates total obligations; this data gap is material to the credit assessment.

credit_strengths.text: GE Vernova 的資產負債表持有可觀的淨現金部位，現金及短期投資遠超所呈報的借款。此淨現金緩衝，加上極低的指示性財務風險狀況，使槓桿遠低於行業中位數，並賦予該公司作為工業資本財發行人罕見的財務靈活性。
營運現金流產生強勁且持續改善，自由現金流輕鬆覆蓋資本支出，並遠超所呈報的債務。現金流對債務及自由現金流對債務比率接近行業百分位區間的頂端，顯示相對於同業具有強勁的內部流動性產生能力。

key_risks.text: 該公司面臨重大關稅成本曝險，在合約保護及緩解措施後，所披露的全年關稅影響達數億美元。未來關稅金額、持續時間及範圍仍不確定，若這些成本無法轉嫁給客戶或透過供應鏈行動抵銷，可能對利潤率構成壓力。
已宣布的 Prolec GE 收購需要數十億美元的付款，由現金及債務平均出資，將在交割時大幅增加借款。此收購相關債務可能使資本結構從淨現金轉向槓桿，且鑑於相對於當前未償還債務的規模，整合或融資執行風險重大。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率異常強勁，營運收入覆蓋已付現金利息的倍數極高。即使 Prolec GE 收購增加債務後，假設電網或電力設備市場需求未出現嚴重惡化，該公司的盈利及現金流基礎應能輕鬆償付增量利息。
扣除資本支出後的自由現金流可觀，覆蓋所呈報債務的倍數極高，而流動比率略低於一，反映大型設備項目典型的營運資金密集特性。鑑於現金餘額，流動性仍然充裕，儘管計入受限制現金可能高估可自由運用的資金。

overall_credit_view.text: GE Vernova 呈現極低的指示性財務風險狀況，擁有淨現金、高利息覆蓋率及強勁的自由現金流產生能力。槓桿及現金流指標與行業中位數相比表現有利，且該公司的電網及電力設備業務受益於電氣化需求，支持建設性的信用觀點。
主要觀察事項為債務融資的 Prolec GE 收購、關稅成本通脹，以及吸收相當比例自由現金流的股東分派。債務指標為部分數據，不包括長期借款，因此所呈報的槓桿可能低估總義務；此數據缺口對信用評估至關重要。
